cues.en: I would agree that we can improve the styling up there and I will do this off screen to prepare you
But what we learned here was really helpful and important.
You learned a lot about svelte core syntax, how you can react to events, how you can bind values in
two directions, how you can work with multiple components by importing and using them, and how you
can pass data around between components, how you can output some content conditionally though we'll
dive deeper into this later in the course and hopefully the core idea and base syntax is clear now.
Now of course, we'll keep on using that throughout the course and then the next section we'll dig even
deeper and learn more cool core features, which you have to know if you're building svelte applications.
Most importantly, we'll dive into loops and conditionals.
So how you could output entire chunks of HTML code only when a certain condition is met and how you
can easily replicate chunks of code in your markup without you having to write it over and over again.
